in_hebrew.name: בַּבס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Babs in Hebrew is derived from the Hebrew word ‘בַּב’ (bav), meaning ‘father’. The Hebrew name Babs is a variant of the name Ab, which is also derived from the same Hebrew root.

in_greek.name: Βάβς
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Babs in Greek is derived from the Greek word ‘βάβας’ (babas), meaning ‘father’. It is a Hellenized form of the Hebrew name Ab.

in_latin.name: Babs
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Babs in Latin is a direct translation of the Greek name Βάβς (Babs), which means ‘father’.
